GARVI 2.0

IGR Department
Government of Gujarat
Garvi (Automation of Administration of Registration, Valuation & Indexing in Gujarat) is a web based application that provides services to citizens to submit document details for registration and online facility to pay Stamp Duty and Registration Fee.
